title: GitHub Project mirror
description: Mirrors `.planning/` phase and plan state into a GitHub Project v2 board, one-way (disk → GitHub). Default-off. Phase 1 ships only the capability shell and an auth preflight (`gsd-tools github-sync preflight`); the sync engine, bootstrap, and issue/sub-issue writes land in later phases.

github_sync.enabled.description: Enable the github-sync GitHub Project v2 mirror capability.

github_sync.target.owner.description: GitHub repository owner for the closed github-sync target.

github_sync.target.repo.description: GitHub repository name for the closed github-sync target.

github_sync.target.repository_number.description: Positive GitHub repository number for the closed github-sync target.

github_sync.target.project_number.description: Positive GitHub Project v2 number for the closed github-sync target.

github_sync.project_title.description: Title used when `init` creates a Project v2 board (empty means the repository name followed by the word Roadmap).
